messages:
Elena Garcia: Heads-up: partner infra requested a checklist for marketplace quickstarts that includes: terraform module versioning policy, security scan steps, and a simple A/B rollback matrix for releases. Can we standardize?
Ravi Shah: we should include a pinned tf module version range in overlays (e.g., =1.2.x) and an automatic compatibility test in CI that deploys the module pinned and the module latest to catch regressions.
Marta Kozlov: security scans: run tfsec and an SCA tool on the overlay repo. include a simple script to scrub secrets from logs before uploading artifacts.
CI-Bot: Security scan scheduled: secscan/overlay-372 (in progress)
Elena Garcia: rollback matrix: define canary %s for marketplace vs direct quickstart: 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with automated healthchecks and auto-rollback on error rate > 5% over 5m. We can reuse Console rollout configs.
Ravi Shah: note: add instructions for partners to provide a minimal SLA statement and support contact for listings. Marketplace teams require it.
Marta Kozlov: ok I'll draft a template for the checklist and drop in the repo under docs/partner-checklist.md
Elena Garcia: thanks. timeline: need first version by 3755552800 so partner PMs can review.
